newsitem.title: UK: Weaker barge premiums limit NWE gas oil gains.
newsitem.headline: Weaker barge premiums limit NWE gas oil gains.

text.p: NWE spot gas oil prices firmed on Monday morning, although weaker heating oil barge premiums ahead of the expiry of May IPE futures wiped out most of the futures-led gains, traders said.

Heating oil barges were offered at May IPE +50 cents and bid below screen. May IPE futures expired at 1100 GMT when it last traded $1 up at $171.75 a tonne with the May/June spread around $2.75 a tonne in backwardation.

Physical traders said the published delivery volume against the screen was not likely to be too high after a number of exchange for physical (EFPs) deals had been concluded, notably between two large trade houses.
Diesel cargoes were offered at June IPE +$12-13 with bids around $2 lower while FOD was pegged unchanged at around June IPE +4-5 and Russian valued around June IPE +3.50 cif NWE.
